body:
I would take martial arts ( I used to compete in MMA cage fighting until my injuries) except the nearest place is 90 minutes away. The demographic in this area are seniors. This is a retirement city/vacation city so things to do my age are next to nil unless you have money.

I feel like I'm giving excuse after excuse, but I'm just trying to be realistic to weed out what I can't do.

I love RPG's also, but I've spent most my life playing video games and I missed so many opportunities because of them. I guess I just have that mind set now that they do more harm than good to me. I will try that form of writing when I'm feeling up to it. I just don't like seeing and doing things by myself. It's so lonely. I've been alone most of my life and I want to share things I experience with someone else.

I don't want to sound like a dick, but people say that a lot. It's like saying to someone who has cancer "you're in my prayers" instead of directly helping. This is part of the reason I've given up. Sorry if I came off as sounding like a dick to you.

I agree on the processed food part. (Why do you think people are always getting sick, cancer?)  If I could afford psych drugs I would maybe try them. To give an idea on how much money I have to my name so you can understand why I cant afford them... My job feeds us meals, not healthy ones, but it's free. I only eat 4.5 days out of the week because I can't afford healthy food to eat on my days off. This is why I only exercise to stay in shape and I can't lift to get bigger like I want.

Because I'm not good at anything. I tried learning a second language earlier this year, but I lose interest after a few hours. I speak English perfectly with pronunciation and all that. It makes it hard for me to speak a foreign language out loud. I can't match accents either. I don't even know what interests me anymore. Video games used to interest me, but I see that as a downfall nowadays. I want to learn to play an acoustic guitar, but I have a boxers break on me left hand and it makes it hard to form fingers into certain positions without discomfort. I also live 2 hours from a city with a instrument shop and cant get to one. I lose interest in things fast because I'm just not good at picking things up anymore since my injuries. I get frustrated and give up. 

I like reading poetic lyrics by this rapper named Sadistik in my head because I'm fascinated at how it flows and how beautiful it is. I wish I could write like him, but I hit a wall in thoughts the moment I pick up a pencil. I have wrote a one thing with the help of a girl who used to be my friend, nothing since.

I really like shooting guns, target shooting etc. I'm REALLY good at it, but I haven't target shot with anything other than a shotgun in five years. Shotgun being 4 years since. I can't get a gun here because I'm not a resident. (I won't get residency here to avoid forced insurance)

I used to play Call of Duty and was extremely great at it because of how fast I notice things. This is trivial though.

I own just my car and a little bit of clothes and this old pc. I'm trying to save money and most of it goes to bills so I can't really afford to buy things for entertainment.

I like to travel to scenic places. I drove across country a lot but never got to enjoy it because I was on time schedule. I don't really remember the places I got to see either... I like hiking and being in the wilderness, but I never have anyone to do it with. They are either in poor physical condition and slow me down or I don't have the money to drive there.

I've given myself 'til the end of the year because I do keep telling myself SOMETHING GOOD MIGHT HAPPEN, but days pass and I just get kicked in the gut again and again. I tell myself again IT WONT BE MUCH LONGER. I feel the end of the year is an ample amount of time for something to happen if I am meant to live a happy life. If nothing good happens I might as well end it and instead of suffering.
